title: Class H Preferred Stock Offering Circular — Terms of the Stock, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
Class H Preferred Stock is the investment class of Member Equities & Patronage. It is sold only to members in good standing who acknowledge the offering circular.

## Terms in force

1. **Who may buy.** Class H Preferred Stock is sold only to members in good standing who acknowledge the offering circular.
2. **Issue.** Shares are issued the class's settlement period in business days after the funds clear.
3. **Redemption request.** A redemption is requested in writing as a preferred redemption request for an amount or the whole holding.
4. **Notice.** A redemption takes effect no earlier than the class's redemption notice period in calendar days after the written redemption request, counted with the request date as day 0, the last notice day itself qualifying. The request date is the date the written request took effect, as recorded on the holding.
5. **Whole-holding redemption.** A redemption that would leave less than the smallest balance that may remain after a partial redemption is made for the whole holding.
6. **Nature of the stock.** Preferred stock is not insured and is not a deposit.

## Notice period illustrated (30 calendar days; hypothetical request taking effect 1 June 2026)

| Day the redemption would take effect | Days after the request date | May take effect |
|---|---|---|
| 1 June 2026 | 0 (the request date) | No |
| 30 June 2026 | 29 | No |
| 1 July 2026 | 30 (the last notice day) | Yes |
| 2 July 2026 | 31 | Yes |

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of the original terms of the stock are no longer in force; each is superseded by the current basis:

- "A purchase must be at least the class's minimum purchase in multiples of the class's purchase increment, may not take the holding above the largest balance a member may hold" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.
- "[A purchase] may not take the holding above the largest balance a member may hold" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.
- "Purchases in one calendar quarter (the sum of the purchases on the member's Class H Preferred Stock holding in the quarter) may not exceed the most preferred stock a member may buy in one calendar quarter" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.
- "Dividends are declared quarterly at the declared annual dividend rate per year on the average daily shares held in the quarter and paid on the 15th day after quarter end, in cash or reinvested according to the dividend option" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.
- "It is paid at par, subject to board approval" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.
- "A partial redemption must leave at least the smallest balance that may remain after a partial redemption" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.

The class figures named in these terms — minimum purchase, purchase increment, largest balance, quarterly purchase limit, declared dividend rate, settlement period, redemption notice period and smallest remaining balance — remain those of the class schedules.
